$comment: Words and addresses the public pages share, kept here so each is written once. attribution is the footer's line on every page and the About page's licence statement. The About page's gaps are the user's to fill: each is the text [TO DECIDE: ...], and one search for TO DECIDE finds every one. Replace a value with the real text and the page shows it with no marker; src/pages/about.astro states the page is a draft only while any marker is left.
